book.name: MULUM PASA
book.title: MULUM PASA Kuate tuku mulum pasa Mosesŋge kuyarna

content: Kuate nu Noa ndoŋ wamdus ulendikina
Kuate nu Noa nuŋe kiŋo kat nuŋe turmba nyaro pasa niŋge lika saniŋgina: Tane kiŋo kulim kile-patikap le tane tuku ndare mbolŋge kilke te kumuŋguwaig.
Ye kile agaŋ ndende ŋakmba tane kulatkam tuku tiŋget. Sar umaŋ kilke mbolok agaŋmor kualegaŋ ŋakmba tane tuku kuru-kuruka minamŋgaig.
Agaŋ ŋakmba likade ta tane tuku nyamagaŋ minig. Ye buk ilinzu ŋakmba tiŋgen taŋamba ndo kile agaŋmor ŋakmba tiŋget.
Tane agaŋmor ndemnu ndare ŋak ŋak ndanyap. Mbulap. Ta ndaŋam? Ndare ta nuŋe abo tugu. Ta tuku tane ndanyap.
Taŋgo andeŋge ko agaŋmor andeŋge taŋgo inum balewa le kumwa ta nu mata kumamŋgat.
Kuate nu taŋgo pino kile-mayokkina ta nuŋe suk. Ta tuku taŋgo andeŋge taŋgo inum balewa ta nu mata kumamŋgat.
Ye tane satiŋget: Tane tugeka kiŋo kulim kile-patikap le kilke kumuŋguwa ŋgina.
Taŋakina sulumba Kuate nu Noa nuŋe kiŋo kat nuŋe ndoŋ teŋenmba saniŋgina:
Tane isap. Ye kile tane ndoŋ wamdus ulendika siŋka son pasa satiŋget te ye siŋka kumuwamŋgit. Ŋgumneŋga tane tuku ndare mbolŋge mata pasa te kumuwamŋgit.
Sar umaŋ agaŋmor tumbraŋok ŋguikok kilke mbolok agaŋ ŋakmba abo minig tane ndoŋ waŋ mbolŋge ibeŋ kinaig ta nane mata tane ŋakmba tuku pasa te saket.
Ye maŋ kule suŋgombi agaŋ ndende ŋakmba kile-ŋgisike nda. Kule suŋgoŋge kilke maŋ ŋayo siliwe nda ŋgina.
Taŋakina sulumba nu maŋ lato saniŋgina: Ye kile tane ŋakmba ndoŋ wamdus ulendiket. Mara mindek taŋamba minmba minamŋgit.
Ta tuku ye kile wanzu kuambor taŋaŋ gau mbolŋge pilet. Kilke mbol mbal ŋakmba nane wanzu ta kaŋgerwaig sulumba pasa te idusamŋgaig.
Yeŋge wi le gau tiŋguwa le wanzu prowa ta
ye siŋka son pasa satiŋget te idusamŋgit. Kule suŋgo maŋ promba tane ŋakmba kile-ŋgisike nda.
Wanzu ta gau mbolŋge minwa le ye kaŋgeri sulumba pasa te idusamŋgit. Ye siŋka son pasa te agaŋ ŋakmba ŋgarosu ŋak abo minig ta tane satiŋget ta siŋka kumuwamŋgit.
Ye kilke mbol mbal ŋakmba ndoŋ wamdus ulendika wanzu kuambor taŋaŋ pilet ŋgina.
Noa tuku kiŋo kame waŋ mbolŋge ibeŋ kinaig ta nyu kat naŋgine Sem Ham Yafet. Kanan nu Ham tuku kiŋo.
Noa tuku kiŋo kame keŋ ta nane tuku ndare tugeka kile sine kilke mbol mbal ŋakmba mineg.
Noa nu Ham kasurna
Noa nu nyam piro ndo kumba minna tuku. Nuŋge tugu pilmba grep piro ande ŋgukina.
Mara ande nu grep kule afu nyina le grep kuleŋge balena le ŋginŋganka baibai sinamŋge tawi kuklikina le wagek kinymba minna.
Taŋana le Kanan mam nuŋe Ham nu mam nuŋe wagek kinymba minna ta kaŋgerna sulumba nu ndek kumba ka aba kat nuŋe sanikina le
Sem nale Yafet ndoŋ nale ndek tawi ande tumba kaika ŋgumnem-ŋgumnem baibai sinam kumba mam nakile kainaik. Nale mam nakile wagek minna ta kaŋgeram mbulmba tumail te-sinaik.
Kile Noa nu ŋgaro purfena le kiŋo ŋgrimbik wam kina ta kubenaik le isna sulumba nu ndek sakina:
Ye kile Kanan kasuri le nu nuŋe tira kame kumnemŋge nane tuku sanzal taŋgo piroka minamŋgat ŋgina.
Taŋakina sulumba nu maŋ lato sakina: Sine Suŋgo tuku nyu te-duŋgube. Nu Sem tuku Mbara. Kanan nu Sem kumnemŋge nu tuku sanzal taŋgo piroka minamŋgat.
Kuateŋge Yafet sinzaŋwa le nu tuku ndare tugekamŋgat. Nu tuku mbuŋ kame Sem tuku mbuŋ kame ndoŋ ulendika minwaig le Kanan nu Yafet kumnemŋge nu tuku sanzal taŋgo piroka minamŋgat ŋgina.
Kule suŋgo ta kugana le Noa nu maŋ lato yar 350 minna.
Nuŋe yar ulendimba ta 950 kusrena sulumba nu kumna.
